scenes.title: Posture is not authority
scenes.body: AtlasGrid opens with REPRICE, HOLD, PENDING HUMAN, and an unsigned record.
scenes.caption: AtlasGrid opens with an analytical posture, not an approval: the workflow is on hold, human authority is pending, and the decision record is unsigned.

scenes.title: Evidence, loss case, gate
scenes.body: The first read explains what matters before model detail.
scenes.caption: The first read states the decisive evidence, the loss mechanism, and the exact diligence gate before exposing model detail.

scenes.title: Clear math can remain on hold
scenes.body: Predeclared thresholds do not substitute for diligence or authority.
scenes.caption: Predeclared return tests can clear while unresolved evidence still prevents the case from advancing.

scenes.title: Progressive lineage
scenes.body: Business meaning comes first; formulas, sources, and hashes stay inspectable.
scenes.caption: Every decision-facing number opens from business meaning into its calculation, retained source selection, and audit metadata.

scenes.title: Find the gate, not the file
scenes.body: Search spans sources, findings, analyses, owners, and requests.
scenes.proof: business search · typed filters · stable routes
scenes.caption: The deal room is searchable by business meaning across sources, findings, analyses, owners, and open requests.

scenes.title: Identification changes model credit
scenes.body: Zero credit, scenario-only credit, and bounded credit are visible decision states.
scenes.caption: Econometric classification changes the investment model: associations receive zero credit and synthetic effects remain bounded to their tested population.

scenes.title: Ask, selected, downside
scenes.body: Each scenario is retained, receipt-bound, and economically distinct.
scenes.caption: AtlasGrid compares seller ask, selected structure, and downside through retained model results rather than presentation-only changes.

scenes.title: Share the exact question
scenes.body: Case, room, scenario, driver, and cell survive reload and browser history.
scenes.caption: The exact case, room, scenario, sensitivity driver, and cell are encoded in a stable, restorable URL.

scenes.title: The same contracts govern VC
scenes.body: Helios extends the shared evidence and judgment system.
scenes.caption: Helios reuses the same evidence, judgment, scenario, and receipt contracts for a milestone-financed venture investment.

scenes.title: Runway bases stay distinct
scenes.body: Current, funded, and no-tranche cash paths are never conflated.
scenes.caption: The interface distinguishes current runway, funded runway, and the no-tranche cash path while separating first-close and conditional capital.

scenes.title: Milestone failure changes economics
scenes.body: The model reruns ownership, cash, preferences, and dated returns.
scenes.proof: withhold tranche → rerun cap table and cash
scenes.caption: A failed milestone withholds the tranche and reruns capitalization, runway, preferences, dated cash flows, ownership, and returns.

scenes.title: Evidence becomes an operating plan
scenes.body: Initiatives carry owners, costs, milestones, stop rules, and value bridges.
scenes.caption: The final layer turns evidence into an owned operating plan with costs, milestones, stop rules, and a reconciled value bridge.

limitations: Both cases and every displayed company record are synthetic.
The capture demonstrates local product behavior, not production adoption or investment performance.
The video is silent with complete SRT and WebVTT captions.
Browser video encoding is reproducible in structure but not claimed byte-identical across platforms.
